description: a young woman elder druid with long wavy auburn hair hanging straight down her back at rest, not flying, a wooden circlet with two large branching brown antlers hung with green leaves and vines, a green dress with a brown leather bodice, a belt with small pouches, brown sleeves, a long thick mantle of orange and golden autumn leaves hanging behind from the shoulders, brown boots, a calm young woman's face in clean profile with one eye, no staff and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the antlers to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look in detail: face, hair, headwear, armour, robes, cloak and colours; the hands empty, without the staff
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
